title: Houses are expensive in Australia – level 2
paragraphs: Houses are very expensive in Australia, so many young people cannot buy their first home. Because of high living costs, more generations are deciding to live together in one house.

Between 2016 and 2021, the number of families living this way increased by 22%. Grandparents are helping by rebuilding their homes or adding small houses in their backyards. This arrangement brings many benefits. Families save money, and parents get extra help with child care.
To help more people, industry experts want the government to change building rules. They want it to be easier for families to build small extra houses, called granny flats, in their backyards.
